summary.text: Erika Booth represents District 35 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Booth is an educator who lives in St. Cloud and previously served as a member of the Osceola County School Board.
Booth holds a bachelor's degree in health science from the University of Florida (2000) and a master's degree in elementary education from the University of Central Florida (2004).
